title: Let vastness loosen your grip
summary: This meets the mind that wants to manage what is far larger than itself. The line opens a different posture: the One is already watching, already present, already beyond your control.
takeaway: Respond to vastness with reverence, not control.
lifeApplication: Before tightening around the outcome, lift the gaze from the screen or the table and feel the room widen. Let presence interrupt the urge to dominate.

source.shortMeaning: The all-present One makes control look smaller than reverence.
source.lifeApplication: When control spikes, widen your attention and remember who is already present.

evidence.coreClaim: The all-present One makes control look smaller than reverence.
evidence.turn: The proper response to vastness is praise, not possession.
